[{#candrasyAyanamivAyanamatra pUrvapadAt saMjYAyAM Ratvam#}
 {#saMjYAyAM dIrGaH svArTe aR vA#} <ls>Tv.</ls>]
_meanings:
A religious observance or expiatory
 penance regulated by the moonʼs age (the period of its waxing and waning);
 (in it the daily quantity of food, which consists of fifteen mouthfuls
 at the full moon, is diminished by one mouthful every day during the dark
 fortnight till it is reduced to zero at the new moon, and is increased
 in like manner

 during the bright fortnight); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Y. 3. 324</ls> {%et seq.%} and <ls>Ms. 11. 217</ls>.
